scripts.install: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && cross-env ENV_FILE=backend/.env ./venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:portal"
